pages.title: The Upper Platform
pages.text: Lets adress the elephant in the room. Yes the signage on the upper platform states "Progress Requires Sacrifice"$(br2)And yes, the massive machine you will construct on the upper levels is called the $(item)Sacrificial Star Engine$().$(br2)I blame our R&D team for making it all sound unsavory.

I am sure they just mean that the sacrifice that will be made is the blood, sweat and tears that is required to build it.$(br2)...Maybe even sacrifice another $(item)Nightstag$() or two$(br2)I am confident that it's not worse than that, so you should put those thoughts out of your mind and get to work!$(br2)After all, there is a ton of things to do before it will be operational.
